new_views.scale_note: Gross anatomy: original scale, 1 model unit = 10 micrometres.

existing_note_updates.Teaching overview: Adult left kidney, adrenal, renal vessels and upper ureter at original gross scale, alongside a uniformly enlarged 15x juxtamedullary nephron. The detached exemplar is a teaching schematic, not an additional gross vessel connection. Home returns to this overview.
existing_note_updates.Juxtaglomerular apparatus: Detached 15x juxtamedullary nephron: macula densa, juxtaglomerular granular cells and extraglomerular mesangium. Explain distal tubular NaCl sensing and local afferent vascular control, with renin release as a separate endocrine response. No renin particles, arterial motion or feedback simulation is provided.

native_path.key: GLBModel.item_key returns (node.name, node.name, None); mesh extras are merged first then node extras; structure_id is the group mapping.
native_path.note_visibility: app/ui/model_view.py shows camera note as tooltip for at most ten long-name views. More than ten uses Views menu; notes then belong in the model teaching content as well.
native_path.limits: No group ids in hidden: names only. set_named_view silently ignores unresolved keys, so enforce resolution before writing.

review_status: Source proposal only; no native launch, buffers, meshes or new renders. Existing README refers to superseded embedded true-scale arrangement. No attributable model render found in bounded searches.
